description: This file provides a utility object 'ClipboardUtil' that facilitates copying text to the system clipboard in an Android application. It handles both successful copy operations and exceptions, providing user feedback via toasts.
external_methods: Toast.makeText(Context context, CharSequence text, int duration)

classes.name: ClipboardUtil
classes.description: A singleton object providing a method to copy text to the system clipboard with appropriate user notifications.

methods.name: copyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies the provided text to the system clipboard. Shows a toast notification indicating success or failure, and logs exceptions if they occur.

parameters.text: The string to copy to clipboard
parameters.showToast: Boolean flag indicating whether to show a toast message (default: true)

calls: Log_OC.e(String TAG, String message, Exception e)
